Low: Ultralight Hip Pack 2L $40; Herschel Heritage Crossbody Twill $45; Herschel Classic Large Tote Twill $50; Nylon Herschel Heritage Tote $100; Herschel Little America Backpack $140; high: All Season Pro Backpack 36L $200. notes: About: named after a small town in Saskatchewan; 'we based our brand in Vancouver, British Columbia'; 'We design classic products that combine style, quality and purpose' (https://herschel.com/pages/about-us). US store is Herschel Supply Co. USA, New York, USD, ships to the US only (https://herschel.com/meta.json).

Free ground shipping on orders over $75; 30 days from delivery to return unused items, minus a flat $5 return-processing fee; exchanges free; final-sale items not returnable (https://herschel.com/policies/refund-policy, https://herschel.com/policies/shipping-policy). Limited Lifetime Warranty on bags, accessories and luggage (https://herschel.com/pages/warranty).
